description: Election Commission - Declare that W. A. L. Widanage was Selected as the Member of the Kegalle Pradeshiya Sabha Declare that K. Satharasinhe was Elected as the Member of the No. 01 Bambara Kele of Nuwara Eliya Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Nuwaraeliya Municipal Council and Kegalle Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of elected members to fill vacancies caused by resignation or party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations for local government positions.
